title: LoveLedger
tagline: A blockchain-based platform that lets couples confirm their love and commitment while creating unique NFTs to commemorate their union.
description: l0veLedger is a revolutionary platform where love meets technology. By leveraging blockchain, it allows couples to validate their mutual commitment through secure transactions and create personalized NFTs featuring vows and AI-generated artwork. It’s love, documented and immortalized for the digital age.
how_its_made: The project is a decentralized application (dApp) built with React for the frontend, utilizing Ant Design for a polished and user-friendly interface. The application integrates with blockchain technology through the Ethers.js library for seamless interaction with smart contracts deployed on the Polygon Network. Remix is used for backend logic and routing, ensuring scalability and maintainability.
